entity.pets-mod.head: Floating Head
message.pets-mod.pet-skin-change-fail: §b[PetsMod] §cEither your currently selected pet doesn't support multiple skins, or that is not a valid skin. Try something else.
message.pets-mod.pet-help:
§b[PetsMod] §aPossible commands:
§a/pethelp: §rdisplays a list of commands
§a/pet <on/off> §rtoggles whether your pet will appear or not
§a/petspecies <species>: §rchanges the species of your pet
§a/petskin <skin>: §rchanges the skin of your selected pet
§a/teleportpet: §rteleports your pet to you. will not work if you are not on the ground.
§a/petname: §rchanges the name of your currently selected pet
message.pets-mod.unsupported-species: §b[PetsMod] §cThat's not a pet that's currently supported. Try something else. (Unknown input %s§c)
message.pets-mod.pet-switched-to: §b[PetsMod] §aYour active pet has been switched to %s§c.
message.pets-mod.pet-switched-to-not-on: §b[PetsMod] §cYour pet has been switched to %s§c, but you currently do not have your pet enabled. Run §l/pet on§r§c to change this.
message.pets-mod.screen.could-not-load-p: ⚠ Could not load 3D model of your pet because you are not in a level.
message.pets-mod.tips-text:
Hi! Here are some quick tips for Pets Mod. 

Shifting and right clicking a pet will pick it up, whereas jumping and 
right clicking a pet will make it sit and stay. Not all pets have a 
 sitting animation, so make sure to note this. 

 You can change/toggle these keybinds in the 
'keybinds' section of the main menu. 

Use /pethelp to view a list of commands. 

Use the 'report issues' button under 'other' to report any 
issues you are having with Pets Mod. 


Finally, don't click this button :)
